audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradict their own why-text and the packet chart, and the packet flags the chart as contradicting a 54.15% win rate. Level 1 reads Akshan while whys[0] says the lane is even; Level 6 and First item read Skill while whys[4] and whys[5] both say Akshan keeps the spacing edge; Two+ items reads Skill while whys[6] says you win any sustained fight.
audit.why: The chart is the first thing a player reads and it disagreed with the paragraph directly under it.
audit.corrected: Level 1 reads Skill, Level 6 and First item read Akshan, Two+ items reads Sylas — matching both the prose and the packet chart. Ratings moved with them.

audit.why: Four spikes exist and cover level 2-3 grapple, level 6 Hijack, Riftmaker and the two-item dive; Comeuppance's long cooldown is already called out as narrowing the level-6 window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors. (a) 'W Dirty Fighting bullets' appears in early and wants.foe[1] — Dirty Fighting is Akshan's PASSIVE (the every-third-hit bonus, shield and extra attack); his W is Going Rogue, the camouflage/Scoundrel ability, and it does no poke at all. (b) Sylas's E is called a stun three times (early, mid, wants.foe[2]) — Abscond/Abduct has no CC in Riot's text or the derived flags; it pulls Sylas to the target.
audit.why: A player told his W is poke will track the wrong cooldown (Going Rogue is 18/14/10/6/2s, Avengerang is 9/8/7/6/5s), and a player expecting a stun on his own E will commit to fights that have no lockdown in them.
audit.corrected: Poke attributed to Avengerang and the Dirty Fighting passive; all three stun references replaced with the pull; Heroic Swing's 12-18s cooldown stated as the commit window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing is named as the matchup-defining cooldown everywhere but never numbered; dosFull[0].d says only 'until it's spent'.
audit.why: 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s is a countable window and every commit rule in the entry hangs off it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid text tells you to punish him 'anchoring onto a minion rather than terrain'.
audit.why: Riot's E description fires the grappling hook into terrain — minions are not anchors. The real error to punish is a swing that ends inside your range.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the swing that lands him back inside chain range.

edits.before: His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: His swing engage and escape — fight only while it is down. That is a 12-18s window; commit inside it.

edits.before: You have no ranged answer to Akshan's W Dirty Fighting bullets at level 1, and your Q Chain Lash requires walking into his auto range to get the crossing explosion — he just steps back. Sit at max Q tip range, last-hit safely, and do not blow your E trying to close before you have W to back up the all-in. His level 1 is also weak in a sustained brawl, so the lane is genuinely even here. At level 2 he gains his E grapple and the dynamic shifts hard against you: he can now swing around terrain to make your E hook whiff, and his W camouflage reset baits you to push past safety. Respect the swing arc — if there is a pillar or minion wave corner he is orbiting, do not commit your Abduct chain because he will simply redirect and your stun misses. Take W at level 2 and bank the heal for when his burst combo lands.
edits.after: You have no ranged answer to Akshan's Avengerang at level 1, and your Q Chain Lash requires walking into his auto range to get the crossing explosion — he just steps back. Sit at max Q tip range, last-hit safely, and do not blow your E trying to close before you have W to back up the all-in. His level 1 is also weak in a sustained brawl, so the lane is genuinely even here. At level 2 he gains Heroic Swing and the dynamic shifts hard against you: he can now swing around terrain to make your E hook whiff, and Going Rogue's camouflage baits you into pushing past safety. Respect the swing arc — if there is a pillar he is orbiting, do not commit your Abduct chain, because he redirects and the pull drags you into nothing. Take W at 2 and bank the heal for his three-hit passive shield.

edits.before: Akshan controls the level 4-5 window almost completely because his grapple mobility keeps him just outside E range while W poke and passive autos tick your HP down. Your W heal helps but it requires getting to him, and he denies that. The plan is to fish for an E hook when he makes a grappling error — landing too close after a swing, or anchoring onto a minion rather than terrain. If you land the chain-pull, the stun into W all-in at low HP is devastating. Level 6 is your inflection point: Hijack gives you Comeuppance, a ranged execute he cannot outrun. The moment he burns his own R, he has no burst safety net — look for your E hook, pull him in, W for the heal spike, and spend the stolen R on the kill. Do not use his R carelessly as a poke tool; you need it for the kill window.
edits.after: Akshan controls the level 4-5 window almost completely because Heroic Swing keeps him just outside E range while Avengerang and his passive autos tick your HP down. Your W heal helps but it requires getting to him, and he denies that. The plan is to fish for an E hook while his swing is on its 12-18s cooldown, or the moment a swing ends inside your range. There is no stun on your chain — the pull is the lockdown, so W immediately after it lands. Level 6 is your inflection point: Hijack gives you Comeuppance, a ranged execute he cannot outrun. The moment he burns his own R, he has no burst safety net — E hook, pull him in, W for the heal spike, and spend the stolen R on the kill. Do not waste his R as poke; you need it for the kill window.

notes: The 'W Dirty Fighting' error appeared twice — his passive was written as his W, so a reader would track the wrong cooldown entirely (Going Rogue 18/14/10/6/2s vs Avengerang 9/8/7/6/5s). Three separate references called Sylas's E a stun; it has no CC, confirmed by both kits and the mirror audit. Spikes are stored out of chronological order (spikes[2] is 'Lvl 2-3' after a 'Lvl 6' entry) — structural, not editable through a text path, flagged for the user.
